rule_level_problems.problem: Gated on the Poisoning concept only; page says 'suspected poisoning/overdose' and there is no overdose concept, so overdose without a Poisoning record will not fire.
Excessive secretions omitted; 'BP < 90/60' split into independent systolic OR diastolic criteria; vomiting uses generic Finding of vomiting (fine).
Task due_to Poisoning and priority rule also requires Poisoning; consistent. No rules for opioid overdose, carbon monoxide or paracetamol conclusions; footnote shock-likely criteria not encoded.

summary: All 12 red-box criteria are encoded with matching SNOMED concepts and thresholds in the Urgent priority rule, and the check_for list agrees with it. The main gaps are the omitted 'excessive secretions' in the organophosphate probable rule, absence of opioid-overdose / carbon-monoxide conclusions, and gating on a Poisoning concept that may not capture 'suspected overdose'.
